title: Companion native conversation controls
description: Run native-conversation-proof.mts setup first with private gateway token, proof state and simulator environment. Proves actual approval, continuation, denial and interruption through Companion.

open.intent: Open the exact private native session using a real app deep link.

wait-approval.intent: Restore the gateway pending approval on the device.

capture-pending.intent: Record the actual pending tool and exact session identity.

approve.intent: Approve the disposable write from Companion.

verify-approved.intent: Prove native approval resolution and the actual file write.

type-continuation.value: What exact token did I ask you to remember? Reply with the token only. Do not use tools.
type-continuation.intent: Continue the same conversation through the mobile composer.

send.intent: Submit the user instruction through the shared session API.

verify-continuation.intent: Assert preserved native identity, prior memory and exactly one command delivery.

prepare-denial.intent: Request a second disposable tool operation for denial proof.

deny.intent: Deny the tool through the real mobile control.

verify-denied.intent: Prove approval resolution and absence of the denied file.

prepare-interrupt.intent: Start a bounded disposable sleep to interrupt.

stop.intent: Interrupt the running native turn from the device.

verify-interrupted.intent: Prove the exact running command emitted native interruption.

capture.intent: Retain the final mobile transcript and controls.

cleanup.intent: Close only the proof session and verify process cleanup.

reload-pending.intent: Reload the real development client while the approval is pending.

wait-replayed-approval.intent: Replay the same pending approval after a fresh mobile connection.

read-only.intent: The closed conversation stays readable and disables input.

capture-history.intent: Record the closed conversation history and disabled composer.

wait-approval-details.intent: Show the complete structured action before approval.

verify-approval-details.intent: Compare the visible approval data with the exact pending request returned by the gateway.

verify-replayed-details.intent: Compare the visible approval data with the exact pending request returned by the gateway.
